article_content: 'German Finance Minister Wolfgang Schaeuble cautioned that Europe's unity is at stake if youth unemployment isn't effectively addressed.  He stressed the need for a balanced approach, advocating for both responsible fiscal management and the preservation of Europe's social safety net. Schaeuble, alongside officials from France and Italy, emphasized the urgency of supporting young Europeans facing job insecurity.  With EU youth unemployment exceeding double the adult rate, at nearly 25%, Schaeuble warned against adopting harsher U.S.-style welfare systems, fearing social unrest.  He highlighted Germany's commitment to tackling the issue through structural reforms, strategic utilization of EU funds (including six billion earmarked for youth employment between 2014 and 2020), and targeted bilateral partnerships with nations like Spain and Portugal.  Echoing the sentiment of a multi-faceted approach, European Investment Bank President Werner Hoyer acknowledged the lack of a 'quick fix.' Italian Labour Minister Enrico Giovannini underscored the gravity of the situation, noting the highly educated yet underemployed younger generation.  While no concrete, unified plan emerged, ministers agreed on a pragmatic, multi-pronged strategy.  Meanwhile, Chancellor Angela Merkel scheduled a youth unemployment conference, and President Francois Hollande proposed a joint eurozone economic government with a dedicated budget for initiatives like youth employment programs. This issue is slated for discussion at a June EU summit. The severity of youth unemployment varies drastically across the EU, from under 8% in Germany and Austria to over 50% in Spain, nearly 40% in Portugal, and a staggering 64% in Greece (as of February 2013).'
translated_content: 'Ministirri Faayinaansii Jarmanii Wolfgang Schaeuble tokkummaa Awurooppaa balaarra bu’uu danda’a jechuun akeekkachiise yoo hojii dhabdummaa dargaggootaa dhaqqabsiisuun hin milkoofne.  Inni mala tasgabbii hawaasummaa Awurooppaa eegsisuun waliin, bulchiinsa faayinaansii itti gaafatamummaa qabuuf falmee, mala walfakkaataa barbaachisummaa irratti xiyyeeffate. Shaa’uble, qondaaltota Firaansiifi Xaaliyaanii waliin, dargaggoota Awurooppaa hojii dhabdummaa mudate deeggaruuf ariifachiisaa ta’uu isaa ibseera. Hojii dhabdummaan dargaggootaa Awurooppaa dachaa ga’umsa guddaa irra ga’ee, gara 25% yoo ta’u, Shaa’uble sirna tasgabbii hawaasummaa Ameerikaa akka hin fudhanne akeekkachiise, jeequmsaa hawaasummaa sodaachuun.  Inni Jarman rifoormiiwwan caasaa, itti fayyadama qusannoo fandiiwwan EU (gara biliyoona ja’a gidduu 2014 fi 2020’tti hojii dargaggootaaf ramaduu dabalatee), fi tumsa biyyaa waliin walfakkaataa biyyoota akka Ispeen fi Poorchugaal waliin hojjechuuf waadaa galtee ibseera. Yaada mala walxaxaa ta’e irra deebi’uun, Pireezidaantiin Baankii Investimantii Awurooppaa Werner Hoyer furmaata hatattamaa akka hin jirre beeksiseera. Ministirri Hojii Xaaliyaanii Enriiko Giovannini rakkina isaa cimaa ta’uu, dhaloota barate garuu hojii dhabdummaa mudate kaasun ibseera. Tooftaa ifa ta’e, tokkicha ta’e tokko illee yoo hin argamin, ministeroonni mala walfakkaataa, toftaa baay’inaa qabu irratti walii galaniiru. Gama biraatiin, Chaansileriin Angilaa Merkel konfiransii hojii dhabdummaa dargaggootaa qopheessite, Pireezidaantiin Firaansi Firaankooyis Holand bulchiinsa diinagdee Awurooppaa gamtaa sagantaa hojii dargaggootaa dabalatee baajata mataa isaa qabu akka uumuuf waamicha dhiheessee jira. Dhimmi kun walga’ii guddaa EU Ji’a irratti mari’atama. Cimaa ta’uu hojii dhabdummaa dargaggootaa Awurooppaa keessatti addaddaa dha, Jarmanii fi Awustiriyaa keessatti 8% gadi irraa hanga Ispeen keessatti 50% olii, Poorchugaal keessatti gara 40%, fi Girii keessatti gara 64% (akka Fulbaana 2013’tti).'

article_content: 'Three celebrities, Binky Felstead, Kristina Rihanoff, and Luisa Zissman, have launched a Breast Cancer Care campaign by posting makeup-free selfies.  The #DareToBare campaign encourages women to go without makeup in October (Breast Cancer Awareness Month) and seek sponsorship. Participants can choose to forgo makeup for a day, a week, or the entire month.  The campaign aims to raise funds for breast cancer sufferers in the UK. Binky, Kristina, and Luisa tweeted their support, urging others to join.  Breast cancer is the most common cancer in women, with 55,000 diagnoses and nearly 12,000 deaths annually in the UK. Andy Harris, director of fundraising and marketing at Breast Cancer Care, emphasized the importance of supporting those affected. The campaign is also backed by online beauty retailer Escentual.com.  Escentual's beauty editor, Emma Leslie, highlighted the simplicity and powerful statement of going makeup-free. Escentual will donate £1 for the first 1,000 women who tweet their #DareToBare photos to @BCCare and/or @escentualdotcom. Donations and sign-ups for sponsorship can be made through the official JustGiving page.'

Duulli #DareToBare jedhamu kun dubartoota akka Onkoloolessa (Jiʼa Hubannoo Kaansarii Harmaa) keessa meekiʼappii osoo hin fayyadamin akka turan jajjabeessa, qarshii deeggarsas ni barbaada. Hirmaattonni guyyaa tokko, torban tokko ykn jiʼa guutuu meekiʼappii fayyadamuu dhiisuuf filannoo qabu. Duulli kun qarshii walitti qabuudhaan namoota Kaansarii Harmaa qaban deeggaruuf yaala. Binkii, Kiristinnaa fi Luʼiisaan deeggarsa isaanii ergaa midiyaa hawaasaa irratti barreessuudhaan ibsanii, warra kaan akka hirmaataniif waamicha dhiyeessan. Kaansariin Harmaa dubartoota irratti mulʼatu keessaa isa baayʼinaan mudatu yoo taʼu, waggaa waggaadhaan UK keessatti namoota 55,000 irratti argamuun, namoota 12,000 taʼan immoo duʼaaf saaxila. Daarektarri fandii walitti qabuu fi daldalaa 'Breast Cancer Care', Aanndii Haarris, namoota dhibee kanaan qabaman deeggaruun barbaachisaa taʼuu hubachiise. Duulli kun 'Escentual.com' jedhamuun beekamu 'online beauty retailer' irraa deeggarsa argateera.  Barreessaan bareedinaa 'Escentual', Emmaa Leslii, meekiʼappii osoo hin fayyadamin turuun salphaa fi ergaa cimaa taʼuu ibsiteerti. Escentual, dubartoota 1,000 jalqabaa suuraa #DareToBare isaanii @BCCare fi/ykn @escentualdotcom irratti maxxansaniif £1 ni arjoomti. Qarshii arjoomuun fi galmeeffamuun deeggarsa gochuuf karaa 'JustGiving page' isa seeraan ala taʼeen ni dandaʼama.'

article_content: 'Five weeks after the Japanese government ordered the evacuation of Tomioka due to radiation concerns from the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear disaster, resident Kazuhiro Shirato returned to his abandoned town.  Accompanied by journalists, he bypassed 'Forbidden Entry' signs, encountering cracked roads but no authorities. Tomioka was a ghost town, buildings mostly intact but eerily silent, with stray animals left behind. Shirato checked on his mother's house, his family's funeral home with its untouched flowers, and finally, his own earthquake-ravaged home, retrieving essential documents.  Returning to temporary housing in Tokyo, Shirato felt a deep sense of loss, particularly the security he once felt living near the plant. He blamed the Tokyo Electric Power Company for falsely assuring him of the plant's safety and expressed dwindling hope of returning home.  Shirato is among over 78,000 people evacuated from the 20-kilometer radius, in addition to thousands more advised to shelter indoors.  Recent government announcements indicate further evacuations due to long-term radiation risks, increasing Shirato's pessimism about his future return.'

Gaazexeessitootaan walitti aanee, mallattoolee 'Seensaan dhorkame' bira darbachaa, karaalee caccaban qofa osoo hin taane abbootii taayitaa tokko illee hin arganne. Tomioka magaalaa ekeraa turte, gamoowwan garuu caalaatti guutuu ta'anii garuu callisanii turan, bineensota godaanan hafanii turan. Shirato mana haadha isaa, mana awwaalcha maatii isaa fi dhuma irrattis, mana isaa mataa isaa isa balaa kirkirri lafaa irraa miidhame ilaalee, sanada barbaachisoo funaanaa fudhate. Gara mana tursiisaa yeroodhaaf Tokiyootti deebi'ee, Shirato miira dhaba guddaa, keessattuu nageenya inni warshaa sanaatti dhihoo jiraachuun isaa duraan itti dhaga'ama ture dhabe. Dhaabbata humna elektirikii Tokiyoon nageenya warshaa sanaa sirriitti mirkaneessuu dhabuu isaanii irratti komate, gara manaatti deebi'uu abdii isaa xiqqaachaa dhufu ibse. Shirato namoota 78,000 ol ta'an raadiyeesii kiilomeetira 20 keessaa godaanan keessaa isa tokko, dabalataan kumaatama namoota mana keessa akka turan gorfamanii turan. Labsiin mootummaa dhiheenya kana ba'e godaansa dabalataa balaa raadiyeeshinii yeroo dheeraa irraa kan ka'e ta'u mul'isa, abdii deebi'uu gara fuulduraa isaa ilaalchisee Shiratoon hammachaa jira.'

article_content: 'In a friendly international match at the Stade de France, France defeated Spain 1-0 thanks to a late goal by Loic Remy.  While Spain maintained control of the ball for much of the game, they were unable to convert their possession into any significant scoring chances.  France, under manager Didier Deschamps, employed an effective counter-attacking approach, which eventually led to Remy's decisive strike in the 74th minute.  This victory for France comes as Spain, managed by Vicente del Bosque, is in a period of transition following the international retirements of key players such as Xavi, Xabi Alonso, and David Villa.'

Ispeen yeroo dheeraa tapha kanaa kubbaa qabachuun taphatte illee, qabxiiwwan galchii barbaachisoo ta'anitti jijjiiruun hindandeenye.  Firaans, leenjisaa Didiyee Deeshaamps jalatti, mala ittisa mormii bu'a qabeessa fayyadamuun, dhuma irratti daqiiqaa 74ffaatti galchii murteessaa Reemiitti geesse. article_content: A mother-of-two, Beverly Smith, 32, and her unborn baby girl were killed Saturday in a multi-vehicle collision in Ohio.  Just two weeks shy of her due date, Mrs. Smith and her husband, Eric, 33, were driving home to Middleville, Michigan, from a medical trip to New Jersey when they encountered whiteout conditions on I-90 near Sandusky, Ohio. Mrs. Smith was in the passenger seat reading a bible when their Ford F-150 was involved in a collision with at least eight vehicles, including six semi-trucks. One tractor-trailer jackknifed and collided with the Smiths' truck, pinning it underneath.  It took emergency responders two and a half hours to extricate Mrs. Smith. She was transported to the hospital and tragically pronounced dead along with her unborn baby. Her husband, Eric, also sustained injuries, but none were life-threatening.  He briefly held their stillborn daughter, whom they planned to name Grace, according to his aunt, Kathy Van Faasen, who spoke with MLive. 'People need to know that we're more than just that crash, that God has a plan for me and God had a plan for Bev,' Eric said, according to Van Fassen. 'There's still hope in the middle of tragedy.' The Smiths' other children, 3-year-old Claire and 1-year-old Sam, are being cared for by family members. Mrs. Smith had been experiencing weakened vision due to Retinitis pigmentosa since November. The couple traveled to New Jersey for acupuncture treatment, which improved her vision. Mr. Smith's aunt says he finds comfort in his faith. He retrieved the bible Mrs. Smith was reading, which had a bookmark on the page she was on, and plans to give it to his daughter when she is older. Friends and family remember Mrs. Smith as an avid runner. The Ohio State Police reported dangerous road conditions with heavy snow and limited visibility at the time of the accident. Six other people received minor injuries but declined medical treatment. The accident is under investigation.

article_content: Hurricane Rick, a powerful Category 5 storm, is currently moving across the Pacific Ocean towards Mexico. As of Sunday, the hurricane's eye was located approximately 725 kilometers south of Cabo San Lucas, with hurricane-force winds extending outwards for 95 kilometers.  While Rick packed winds of up to 290 km/h (180 mph) on Sunday—making it the second strongest eastern North Pacific hurricane in over ten years, behind only 1997's Hurricane Linda (298 km/h/185 mph)—it's predicted to decrease in intensity to a Category 4 hurricane by Sunday night.  The U.S. National Hurricane Center forecasts that Rick will continue on a northeastern curve, hitting southern Baja California by Wednesday morning before tracking towards mainland Mexico.  Experts anticipate further weakening as the hurricane progresses inland.

article_content: A new Formula One regulation prohibiting driver coaching through team radios is now effective. This rule change was highlighted by a tense qualifying session at the Singapore Grand Prix, where Mercedes teammates Lewis Hamilton and Nico Rosberg battled for pole position. Rosberg, currently leading the championship by 22 points, expressed frustration after being narrowly beaten to pole by just 0.007 seconds. Hamilton's pole position gives him a strong starting position to challenge Rosberg's lead in Sunday's race.  Red Bull's Daniel Ricciardo and Sebastian Vettel qualified third and fourth respectively, showing competitive pace.  The new rule aims to increase driver autonomy during races by preventing teams from giving specific instructions on how to drive the circuit.

article_content: Developed by Katakai Fireworks Co in Niigata Prefecture, Japan, the Yonshakudama holds the title of the world's largest single firework. This colossal firework weighs a staggering 930 pounds and measures an impressive 48 inches in diameter.  When ignited, it soars to an altitude of 2,700 feet and boasts a bloom diameter exceeding 2,400 feet.  Every year, on September 9th and 10th, the Yonshakudama is a central feature of the Katakai-Matsuri Festival in Katakai town.  The firework's creation is a meticulous process overseen by Masanori Honda, with rigorous safety measures in place at the factory.  British photographer Tony McNicol documented the construction process during his time in Japan, capturing images of the meticulous work involved.  The Yonshakudama is a stark contrast to the fireworks employed in the extreme sport of pyrotechnic skydiving, where skydivers ignite smaller fireworks while freefalling at speeds of up to 120mph. The Yonshakudama is available in two varieties: 'Brocade crown over small flowers' and 'Floral shell of shells twice blooming'.
translated_content: Jaappaanitti, Niigata Prefecture keessatti Katakai Fireworks Co'n hojjetame, Yonshakudama jedhamu addunyaa kana irratti firiwoorkii tokkicha guddicha ta'uu isaatiin beekkama. Firiwoorkii guddaan kun paawundii 930 ulfaata waan ta'eef, daayaameetiri isaa incii 48 dha.  Yeroo itti qabsiifamu, ol fageenya fiitii 2,700tti ol ba'a, daayaameetiri bal'ina isaa fiitii 2,400 ol ta'a.  Waggaa waggaadhaan, Fulbaana 9 fi 10 irratti, Yonshakudama kun magaalaa Katakai keessatti ayyaana Katakai-Matsuri jedhamu irratti mul'ata guddaa ta'a.  Hojjetamuun firiwoorkichaa kun tooftaa of eeggannoo cimaa qabuun Masanori Honda'n hogganama. Fakkii kaasuun lammii Ingilizii Tony McNicol yeroo Jaappaan jiraachaa ture adeemsa hojjetamuu isaa suuraa kaasuun galmeesse. Yonshakudama kun firiwoorkiiwwan ispoortii balaa guddaa qabu 'pyrotechnic skydiving' jedhamu keessatti itti fayyadamaniin baay'ee adda dha, sababiin isaas ispoortii kana keessatti namooti samii keessaa kufaatii fiitii 120/sa'aatii xinnoo firiwoorkiiwwan qabsiisu. article_content: In the wake of a year filled with devastating floods, tornadoes, and wildfires, Tad Skylar Agoglia's First Response Team of America has become increasingly vital. Currently assisting in Iowa, this self-funded nonprofit, comprised of Agoglia and a four-man crew, offers immediate disaster relief. Agoglia founded the team after witnessing firsthand the delays in traditional disaster recovery efforts.  Having worked with his previous company, Disaster Recovery Solutions, on cleanups after events like Hurricane Katrina, he recognized the critical need for rapid response in the initial days following a disaster, a period often marked by a lack of accessible resources for those in need.  'The first few days are the most important,' Agoglia emphasizes, 'That's when people desperately require medical help, food, and water.'  His team utilizes over $1 million worth of specialized equipment, including crane-equipped trucks capable of clearing massive amounts of debris and a hovercraft for navigating flooded areas.  'Small towns often struggle to get help after a disaster,' Agoglia notes. 'We can come in and clear an entire town in just two days.' Agoglia's commitment to the team has meant pausing his other business ventures and depleting personal savings to cover the $45,000 monthly operational cost.  Although facing financial constraints, Agoglia remains dedicated, believing that the impact on communities across America justifies the sacrifice. He dreams of expanding the First Response Team nationwide, with support from corporate and federal sponsors, to ensure quicker and more widespread disaster relief.

Yeroo ammaa kana Iowa keessatti gargaaraa jira, dhaabbati tola ooltummaa ofiin maallaqa argatu kun, Agogliaa fi miseensota afurii of keessaa qaba, gargaarsa balaa tasaa kenna. Agoglia garee kana hundeessuun isaa dura, harkasaa jalqabaan turtii deebii balaa idil-addunyaa keessatti argame ilaalee ture.  Kombiniyaa isaa duraanii, Disaster Recovery Solutions, waliin hojiiwwan qulqulleessuu balaa obomboleettii Kaatriinaa booda irratti erga hojjatee booda, barbaachisummaa cimaa deebii saffisaa guyyoota muraasa jalqabaa balaa booda, yeroo baay'ee hanqina qabeenyaa argachuu namoota balaan miidhaman qabuun beekame, hubate. 'Guyyoonni muraasni jalqabaa hunda caalaa barbaachisoo dha,' Agoglia ni hubachiisa, 'Yeroon kun namooti gargaarsa fayyaa, nyaataa fi bishaan baayyee barbaadanidha.' Gareen isaa meeshaalee adda ta'an doolaara miliyoona 1 ol ta'an fayyadama, isaan keessaa konkolaattota qorriin qabatan meeshaalee hedduu qulqulleessuu danda'an fi dooni lafa bishaanii keessa socho'uu danda'u naannoo balaan miidhame keessa socho'uuf gargaaru. 'Magaalota xixiqqoon yeroo baay'ee gargaarsa argachuuf rakkatu balaa booda,' Agoglia ni dubbata. 'Nuti dhufnee magaalaa guutuu guyyaa lama keessatti qulqulleessuu dandeenya.' Of kennummaan Agogliaa garee kanaaf hojiiwwan daldalaa isaa kan biroo dhaabuu fi qusannaa ofii isaa kaffaluuf doolaara 45,000 baasii ji'aa guuttachuuf oolchuu jechuudha. Rakkoolee maallaqaa qabaatus, Agoglia of kennee itti fufee jira, dhiibbaa hawaasa Ameerikaa irratti qabu wareegama kaffaluu qaba jedhee amanuun isaa ti. Garee Deebii Saffisaa guutummaa biyyaa keessatti babal'isuu, deeggarsa kaffaltoota koorporeeshinii fi federaalaa waliin, deebii balaa saffisaa ta'e fi bal'aa ta'e mirkaneessuuf hawwii qaba.

article_content: 'The legendary Rolling Stones surprised fans with a last-minute gig at the intimate La Trabendo club in Paris on Thursday.  Announcing the secret show mere hours beforehand on Twitter, the band released 350 tickets at the unbelievably low price of €15 each.  Around 600 lucky fans packed the venue to witness Mick Jagger, Keith Richards, Charlie Watts, and Ronnie Wood rock out.  Kicking things off with 'Route 66,' they quickly transitioned into the iconic 'It's Only Rock and Roll.'  Jagger, marveling at the band's stamina, joked with the crowd, 'I can't believe we're all still standing up! You'd think at least one of us would be sitting down by now.'  The setlist blended classic hits with their recently released track 'Doom and Gloom' - their first new music together in seven years, which, as Jagger tweeted earlier, was recorded in Paris and features a video with Swedish actress Noomi Rapace.  The main set concluded with 'Midnight Rambler,' followed by an encore of 'Jumping Jack Flash' and 'Brown Sugar.' The show is part of the band's 50th-anniversary celebration, which also includes four arena shows: two at London's O2 arena on November 25th and 29th, and two more at Newark's Prudential Center on December 13th and 15th.'
translated_content: 'Rooling Stoons jedhaman leejjindaarii ta'an, albaatii Kamisa darbe Paarisitti kilabii La Trabendo jedhamu keessatti qophii muuziqaa dinqisiisaa ta'een akka hin eegamneen dhihaate.  Konsartii iccitii ta'e kana sa'aatii muraasa dura Tiwiitara irratti beeksisaniiru, tiikeetiiwwan 350 gatii €15 qofa ta'een gurgurame.  Deeggartoonni carraa qaban 600 ta'an iddoo sana guutanii, Miik Jaaggar, Keeth Riichaards, Chaarli Waats fi Roonii Wuud yeroo taphatan daawwachuuf.  'Route 66'tiin jalqabanii, battaluma sanatti weedduu beekama ta'e 'It's Only Rock and Roll' itti fufaniiru.  Jaaggar jabina garee muuziqaa kanaa dinqisiifatee, namoota walitti qabamanitti, 'Hundumti keenya dhaabannee jirra jechuun waanan amanuu hin dandeenye! Amma yoonaan tokko yookiin lama keenya taa'anii jiraanna jettanii yaaddu ta'a' jechuun qoosaa dubbate.  Weedduuwwan durii waliin weedduu 'Doom and Gloom' jedhamu haarawaa baasanii taphatan - weedduu haaraa waggaa torba booda walfaana baasan isa jalqabaa ta'e, kunis, akka Jaaggar kanaan dura Tiwiitara irratti barreesseetti, Paarisitti waraabamee fi viidiyoo isaa keessatti taphattuun Iswiidin Noomii Rapaasee argamti.  Taphni inni guddaan 'Midnight Rambler'tiin xumuramee, itti aansee 'Jumping Jack Flash' fi 'Brown Sugar' taphataniiru.  Qophiin kun kabaja waggaa 50ffaa garee muuziqaa kanaatiin kan wal qabatu yoo ta'u, qophiiwwan istaadiyeemii afur dabalataas ni qabaata: lama Adoolessa 25 fi 29 irratti Landanitti O2 areenaa keessatti, lamas Deesimbira 13 fi 15 irratti Niiwark Praadeshaal Seentara keessatti.'
